question: How is our Caitra such, being as it were variegated?
premises: But shining-as-variety gives birth to the variegated state.
Thus this Caitra of ours, being as it were variegated, is such.
inference: Variety-shining births the variegated state instanced in ordinary Caitra.
plain_english: But shining-as-variety gives birth to the variegated state; thus this Caitra of ours, being as it were variegated, is such.
